item.title: Implant – an extension to VS Code that exposes its APIs to coding agents
item.description:
📝 Give coding agents (Copilot Chat, Claude Code, Cursor, anything that speaks MCP — or anything that can shell out) live access to everything that lives inside VS Code and third-party extensions. Modify the code through the same language server that powers the editor: structural rename, quick-fixes and refactors, organize imports, safe file create/rename/delete via WorkspaceEdit, formatter output, source actions. Implant exposes a single MCP tool, run_vscode_script, that executes a JavaScript snippet inside the running VS Code extension host with full access to the vscode.
🔗 Read more: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=strangepleasures.implant
